metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.9 · 1932 · The Mummy
metas.description: A resurrected Egyptian mummy searches Cairo for the girl he believes to be his long-lost princess.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.0 · 1940 · The Mummy's Hand
metas.description: Archaeologists defile the tomb of mummified Kharis, who was buried alive for falling in love with an Egyptian princess.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.5 · 1942 · The Mummy's Tomb
metas.description: The ancient Egypt Mummy, Kharis, is transported from his homeland with the high priest Mehemet to wreak vengeance on the family who has defiled the sacred tomb of his beloved Princess Ananka.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.5 · 1944 · The Mummy's Ghost
metas.description: Kharis the mummy is given a sacred potion that grants him eternal life to search for his lost love, Princess Ananka, despite the unending curse that haunts them.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 5.4 · 1944 · The Mummy's Curse
metas.description: Shipped to Louisiana, the mummy Kharis from Egypt roams the bayou, tormented by his forbidden love for Princess Ananka.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.2 · 1955 · Abbott and Costello Meet the Mummy
metas.description: Two bumbling Americans stumble on the discovery of a lifetime when their search for a mummy leads them to a sacred medallion that holds the key to buried treasure.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 6.6 · 1959 · The Mummy
metas.description: In 1895, British archaeologists find and open the tomb of Egyptian Princess Ananka with nefarious consequences.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 5.6 · 1964 · The Curse of the Mummy's Tomb
metas.description: British archaeologists and their American investor ship an Egyptian mummy's sarcophagus to London but someone has the amulet to revive the mummy that will then kill all those who disturbed its tomb.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 5.5 · 1967 · The Mummy's Shroud
metas.description: In 1920 an archaeological expedition discovers the tomb of an ancient Egyptian child prince. Returning home with their discovery, the expedition members soon find themselves being killed off by a mummy, which can be revived by rea...

metas.name: 10 · ★ 5.6 · 1971 · Blood from the Mummy's Tomb
metas.description: An archaeological expedition brings back to London the coffin of an Egyptian queen known for her magical powers. Her spirit returns in the form of a young girl and strange things start to happen.

metas.name: 11 · ★ 7.1 · 1999 · The Mummy
metas.description: At an archaeological dig in the ancient city of Hamunaptra, an American serving in the French Foreign Legion accidentally awakens a mummy who begins to wreak havoc as he searches for the reincarnation of his long-lost love.

metas.name: 12 · ★ 6.4 · 2001 · The Mummy Returns
metas.description: The mummified body of Imhotep is shipped to a museum in London, where he once again wakes and begins his campaign of rage and terror.

metas.name: 13 · ★ 5.5 · 2002 · The Scorpion King
metas.description: A desert warrior rises up against the evil army that is destroying his homeland. He captures the enemy's key sorcerer, takes her deep into the desert and prepares for a final showdown.

metas.name: 14 · ★ 5.3 · 2008 · The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
metas.description: In the Far East, Alex O'Connell, the son of famed mummy fighters Rick and Evy O'Connell, unearths the mummy of the first Emperor of Qin -- a shape-shifting entity cursed by a witch centuries ago.

metas.name: 15 · ★ 5.4 · 2017 · The Mummy
metas.description: An ancient Egyptian princess is awakened from her crypt beneath the desert, bringing with her malevolence grown over millennia and terrors that defy human comprehension.
